{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crooked Way''' was a path located on the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] that led from the [[Star Pond]] towards the academy's [[lecture hall]]. It was a serpentine path of rectangular stepping-stones, set askew to each other so that walkers would be forced to slow down and concentrate on their journey through the garden.
